definitions.explanation: Something treated as less important than the main concern, to be dealt with later or not at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二|に}の{次|つぎ}だ。
examples.english: For him work comes first and his family second.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝|か}ち{負|ま}け→勝ち負け：11928_kachimake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二|に}の{次|つぎ}にして、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しもう→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Let's put winning or losing aside and just enjoy the game.

notes:
Usually in X⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二|に}の{次|つぎ}だ (X comes second) or X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|に}の{次|つぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to put X second), often after naming what comes first (⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧, ⟦{最優先|さいゆうせん}→最優先：13012_saiyuusen⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二|に}の{次|つぎ}: X is secondary
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|に}の{次|つぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put X second, to neglect X
- {二|に}の{次|つぎ}、{三|さん}の{次|つぎ}: an emphatic form, "way down the list"

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後回|あとまわ}し→後回し：07398_atomawashi⟧: putting something off until later; about order in time, not importance
